title: To the Owner Who Opened Today on Four Hours of Sleep

scenes.say: Cafe owners, this one's for you.
You were up before five. Lights on at six. Smiling at the first guest by seven. Doing the books after close.

scenes.speaker: Maria
scenes.say: Your cafe is the best part of my morning. I don't think you know that.

props.name: Maria
props.quote: You're the best part of *my morning*.

scenes.say: Nobody claps when the doors open on time. So here it is. We see you. Get some sleep tonight.
Send this to an owner who needs it. Follow for more cafe life.
